patch.value: Protect distribution inventory and staging from concurrent dist rebuilds

The distribution packer reads the live dist tree outside the shared build/test lease. During this delivery an overlapping linked-test rebuild caused npm pack --dry-run to fail with ENOENT for a dist/cli-bundle/chunks file; packing passed when rerun after the rebuild settled. Existing completed producer/test-consumer serialization and physical runtime staging remain valid, but this additional packing consumer is not protected.

Hold a verified consumer lease or equivalent immutable generation throughout source inventory and staging; use real independent build/pack overlap to prove no missing or mixed-generation files; retain fail-closed incomplete-generation handling and existing physical-path guards; do not replace ownership evidence with timer-only fixtures or force lock overrides.
Reliable context and release evidence requires packed consumers to use a consistent tested generation.
Distribution inventory and materialization read one completed artifact generation even when another process rebuilds dist.
